newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-TIMELY INJURY FOR NEWLY-WED ALBERTINI.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-TIMELY INJURY FOR NEWLY-WED ALBERTINI.

text.p: Footballers do not usually welcome injuries but it is possible that Milan's international midfielder Demetrio Albertini is not entirely unhappy about the one he has at the moment.
For a leg injury has ruled him out of Italy's squad for their World Cup qualifier in Moldova on Saturday and means he can go on honeymoon with his new bride instead.
On Monday, Albertini, 25, married Oriana Capone, a 22-year-old student in a church just down the road from the Albertini family home.
Adding a further family touch was the fact his elder brother Demetrio, a priest, conducted the service.
